question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: **Belligerent**
solution:
The correct answer is: **3) Peaceful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Belligerent"** refers to someone or something that is hostile, aggressive, or eager to fight. (युद्धप्रिय, आक्रामक)
 
 
• **Example:** The belligerent tone of his speech only escalated the conflict.
 
 
• **"Peaceful"**, on the other hand, means free from disturbance; calm or tranquil. It is the opposite of belligerent. (शांत)
 
 
• **Example:** After a long day, she enjoyed a peaceful evening at the park.
